spans.s:
(ऋ) श्रोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्रोणति)
To accumulate, to heap together.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Dressed, cooked, matured.
m. (-णः)
A cripple.
f. (-णा)
1 The constellation Śravaṇā.
2 Rice-gruel.
E.
श्रोण to heap together, aff. अच्; or शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. न.

f. (-णिः-णी)
1 The hip and loins.
2 A road, a way.
E.
श्रोण to heap, aff. इन्; or श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. नि.

n. (-कं)
1 The hip and loins, or the hip only.
2 The hip-bone, the os ilium.
E.
श्रोणि the same, and फल fruit, कन् aff. of comparison, or फलक a plank; also श्रोणिफल n. (-लं)

n. (-म्बं)
A string worn round the loins.

n. (-तः)
1 The ear.
2 The current of a stream.
3 An organ of sense.
E.
श्रु to hear or to leak, aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment.

n. (-तः)
1 A current, a natural or rapid stream.
2 A river in general.
3 The flow or course of water.
4

Water.
5

A spring.
6 An organ of sense.
E.
स्रु to flow, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment; also with a final vowel स्रोत, and palatial sibilant श्रोतस्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be heard or listened to.
E.
श्रु to hear, तव्य aff. of the future participle.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Hearing, a hearer, who hears.
E.
श्रु to hear, तृच् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
The ear.
E.
श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Melodious, musical, sounding agreeably.
E.
श्रोत्र, and सुख pleasure.

ind.
The five senses.
E.
श्रोत्र, and आदि etcetera.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Modest, docile, well-behaved.
m. (-यः)
1 A Brahman versed in the study of the

Vedas.
2

A Brahman following [] a particular branch or school of the Vedas.
E.
श्रोत्र considered as substituted for छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and खन् aff.; or श्रोत्र the ear, said also to mean the Vedas, and घ aff.

f. (-ता)
Conversancy with the Vedas, the duty of a Brahman.
E.
श्रोत्रिय a priest acquainted with the Vedas, and तल् aff.

n. (-स्वं)
The property of a learned Brahman.
E.
श्रोत्रिय, and स्व own.

n. (-तं)
A natural or rapid stream: see स्रोतस्.

m. (-शः)
The ocean.
E.
स्रोतस् a stream, and ईश lord.

IVA.
2

A thief.
E.
स्रोतस् a stream, यत् aff.

f. (-ती)
A river.
E.
स्रोतस् a current, मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-नी)
A river.
E.
स्रोतस् a current, and विनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Antimony.
E.
स्रोतस् a stream, and अञ्जन collyrium.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Flowing like a stream or river.
f. (-हा)
A river in general.
E.
स्रोतस् a stream, and वह bearing.
